brief.meaningEn: A situation at a new level has substantially different demands, standards or consequences from a familiar one, even when the activity seems related.
brief.meaningZh: 事情進入新層次後，要求、標準或後果與熟悉的階段有實質差別，即使表面仍屬同一類活動。
brief.grammar: Use “X is a different game altogether” after naming the new situation. Game is figurative; altogether intensifies the contrast. The construction compares levels or conditions, not necessarily two people with opposing goals.
brief.register: Conversational to neutral figurative description. A manager may explain a scale change to a colleague, or a mentor may warn a trainee that a professional setting demands more preparation.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是新階段的要求實質改變，不只是換了場地、名稱或參與者；也不是兩方目標不同的 playing different games。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不要因為規模略增或地點轉換便說是完全另一回事；應指出至少一項新的標準或責任。
brief.outcomeZh: 能在相關活動升級時，指出新增要求，並分清層次轉變與兩方目標不同。

listening.promptEn: Why does the organiser call the larger event a different game altogether?
listening.promptZh: 籌辦者為甚麼說大型活動完全是另一個層次？

options.en: Serving many guests adds allergy controls and a new scale of planning.
options.zh: 接待大量來賓，須新增過敏原控制並大幅擴充安排。

options.en: She only needs more portions; the same unlabelled buffet will cover the allergy requirements.
options.zh: 她只需增加份量；沿用沒有標示的自助餐檯已足以處理過敏原要求。

options.en: The important change is an earlier start time; allergy labels can be added after guests eat.
options.zh: 重要改變是提早開始；過敏原標示可以待來賓吃完後才加上。

options.en: She can label the food but need not plan serving stations or timing for the larger group.
options.zh: 她可標示食物，但不用為較多人安排分餐台或供餐時間。

listening.explanationZh: 由六位朋友擴至二百位客人，還要建立過敏原標示和分餐安排；新要求不只是改菜單或意見不同。
listening.en: Lena usually cooks for six friends. Catering for 200 guests is a different game altogether: she now needs allergy labels, separate serving stations and a timed food plan.
listening.zh: Lena 平時為六位朋友下廚。為二百位來賓供餐完全是另一個層次：她現在要準備過敏原標示、獨立分餐台和按時間安排的供餐計劃。

reply.promptEn: Our garden group tends one small plot. The council has asked us to care for twelve public plots with safety checks and a weekly rota. How should I explain the change to the volunteers?
reply.promptZh: 園藝小組原本照顧一小塊地。區議會現在請我們照顧十二塊公共園圃，還要做安全檢查和每周值班表。我應怎樣向義工解釋轉變？

options.en: Twelve public plots are a different game altogether; let us plan the safety checks and rota before we agree.
options.zh: 十二塊公共園圃完全是另一個層次；我們先規劃安全檢查和輪值表，再決定是否接手。

options.en: The safety checks add work we did not have before; I would show everyone the requirements and ask about their time.
options.zh: 安全檢查增加了從前沒有的工作；我會向大家展示要求，並問他們能投入多少時間。

options.en: A weekly rota across twelve plots needs more reliable cover than one plot; let us test an extra plot first.
options.zh: 十二塊地的每周輪值比一塊地更需要穩定人手；我們先試照顧多一塊地。

options.en: We cannot promise twelve plots without covering the new safety duties; I would ask the council what support it offers.
options.zh: 未能應付新增安全職責前，我們不能承諾照顧十二塊地；我會先問區議會提供甚麼支援。

reply.explanationZh: 四個回應都向義工點出新增的安全或輪值要求，並提出合理下一步；金句以 a different game altogether 點出層次變化。

scene.promptEn: Jules designs informal posters for a school club. She has now accepted a paid commission for public emergency signs, whose wording must be accessible and pass safety review. Which description fits?
scene.promptZh: Jules 原本替學校社團設計非正式海報，現在接下有酬工作，為公眾設計緊急指示牌；文字須方便不同人士理解，並通過安全審核。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Public emergency signs are a different game altogether because accessibility and safety review add standards her club posters did not face.
options.zh: 公眾緊急指示牌完全是另一個層次，因為易讀性和安全審核是社團海報未遇過的標準。

options.en: She can improve the colours but keep unreviewed wording; the paid commission changes only the fee.
options.zh: 她可以改進顏色，但沿用未經審核的文字；有酬工作只改變報酬。

options.en: Safety review matters, but accessibility can wait until after the signs are installed.
options.zh: 安全審核固然重要，但易讀性可以待指示牌安裝後才處理。

scene.explanationZh: 正式的緊急指示牌須符合易讀及安全標準；另兩句各忽略其中一項須在安裝前完成的要求。

contrast.promptEn: Which situation least supports calling the new stage a different game altogether?
contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不足以說新階段「完全是另一個層次」？

options.en: A local rehearsal becomes a live broadcast with strict timing and accessibility checks.
options.zh: 本地綵排變成現場直播，並須嚴守時間及無障礙安排。

options.en: A volunteer project gains legal responsibility for confidential records and staff supervision.
options.zh: 義工項目新增保管機密紀錄及督導員工的法律責任。

options.en: The same four colleagues hold the same meeting in the room next door, with no change to the agenda or duties.
options.zh: 原來四位同事搬到隔壁房間開同樣的會，議程與職責都不變。

contrast.explanationZh: 只是換房間，標準與責任未變；另兩例有實質新增要求。

dialogue.promptEn: Noah plays piano confidently for friends. A conservatory audition now requires sight-reading unfamiliar music and keeping tempo under assessment. He says his familiar songs are enough. What is the best reply?
dialogue.promptZh: Noah 在朋友面前彈鋼琴很有自信。音樂學院試奏卻要即席讀奏陌生樂譜，並在評核下保持節奏。他說熟悉的曲子已足夠。怎樣回應最好？

options.en: A conservatory audition is a different game altogether; you need to practise sight-reading and steady tempo, not only familiar songs.
options.zh: 音樂學院試奏完全是另一個層次；你不只要彈熟悉的曲子，還須練習即席讀奏及穩定節奏。

options.en: Keep practising your familiar songs and steady tempo; sight-reading can wait until after the audition.
options.zh: 繼續練熟悉的曲子和穩定節奏即可；即席讀奏可以等試奏結束後再練。

options.en: Practise sight-reading now, but deal with the assessed tempo only after the audition.
options.zh: 現在先練即席讀奏；評核中的節奏問題待試奏後再處理。

dialogue.explanationZh: 新階段同時評核即席讀奏及節奏；B 和 C 各把其中一項必要準備推遲至試奏後。

speaking.en: Turning a five-household delivery round into a citywide service is a different game altogether: we would need routes and a way to handle missed deliveries.
speaking.zh: 把五戶人的送貨路線擴展成全市服務，完全是另一個層次：我們需要規劃路線，也要有處理漏送的辦法。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出擴大服務後新增的兩項實際要求。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：科學社曾為六位同學做示範，現在受邀在有六百位來賓的公眾開放日示範。新活動須安排人流及受過訓練的安全員。寫一至兩句英文向社員說明規模轉變和兩項新增要求，不要假裝原有小型安排已足夠。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩例都須寫出原來只有六位同學、如今六百位來賓，並明確寫出人流安排及受過訓練的安全員。

examples.en: Running a science demonstration for six classmates is one thing; the public open day for 600 visitors is a different game altogether, so we need a crowd plan and trained safety stewards.
examples.zh: 為六位同學做科學示範是一回事；面對六百位來賓的公眾開放日完全是另一個層次，所以我們需要人流安排及受過訓練的安全員。

examples.en: Our six-classmate science demo needs only a small table, but an open day for 600 visitors is a different game altogether: we must plan crowd flow and assign trained safety stewards.
examples.zh: 我們為六位同學示範時只需一張小桌子，但六百位來賓的開放日完全是另一個層次：我們必須規劃人流，並指派受過訓練的安全員。

glossary.zh: 指派受過訓練的安全員

takeaways.en: A different game altogether names a substantial change in demands, not merely a new location.
takeaways.zh: a different game altogether 指要求有實質轉變，而不只是換了地點。

takeaways.en: A different game altogether calls for naming new responsibilities instead of assuming earlier success is enough.
takeaways.zh: 完全不同層次的挑戰，需要說清楚新增責任，不能假設過往成功便已足夠。
